activityReview.emptyBody: Payments that look unusual for you will show up here.
activityReview.subtitle: A look back at your spending pattern and any payments ANTON Pay flagged as unusual for you.
activityReview.title: Activity review

addWallet.createHint: A 24-word recovery phrase will be shown next. Back it up before sending FTC to the new address.
addWallet.label: Label
addWallet.title: New wallet
addWallet.agentHint: An agent wallet has its own keypair so an ANTON agent can transact, but it pays under an "ANTON …" identity with you disclosed as the owner (UBO). Use it to keep tabs on what the agent is doing.

backup.continueToVerify: I have written it down — continue
backup.showBody: These 24 words are the only way to recover your wallet if you lose this device. Anyone with them can spend your funds. Write them down on paper and keep them somewhere safe — never in a photo, screenshot, or cloud note.
backup.tapToReveal: Tap to reveal — only you should see this
backup.verifyBody: Enter the words at the positions shown to confirm you saved the phrase correctly.
backup.verifyWrong: One or more words don't match. Check your written copy.
backup.warning: FutureChain cannot help you recover this phrase if it is lost. Your wallet, your responsibility.

fraud.payAnywayHint: Tap again only if you're sure this payment is right.

signal.above-typical: About {{factor}}× larger than the typical payment size you set.
signal.amount-anomaly: About {{factor}}× larger than your usual payment.
signal.dormancy-break: Your first payment in {{days}} days, and a large one.
signal.expiring-qr: This code is about to expire — don't let anyone rush you.
signal.monthly-cap: This pushes your 30-day spending past the {{expected}} FTC you expect to spend in a month.
signal.new-counterparty: You've never paid this recipient before.
signal.new-counterparty-large: A large payment to a recipient you've never paid before.
signal.odd-hour: You don't usually make payments at this time of day.
signal.velocity: {{count}} payments already in the last 24 hours.

friends.title: Friends

fx.rateUnavailable: Rate unavailable — enter amount in FTC. Fiat display will return when the FutureChain oracle is live.

home.syncNow: Sync now — listen for incoming payment

moneyProfile.privacyNote: This is a personal record kept only on this phone. ANTON Pay never sends it anywhere. It is not an identity check — it is the baseline the app compares new payments against.
moneyProfile.sourceOfFunds: Where your money mainly comes from
moneyProfile.subtitle: A private picture of who you are and what your normal money pattern looks like. ANTON Pay uses it to flag payments that look unusual for you. Every field is optional.
moneyProfile.title: Money profile

onboarding.contextBody: Set your language and where you're tax resident so payment records and tax estimates are right from the start. You can change these any time in Settings.
onboarding.doneBody: Your wallet is set up and secured on this device. Scan a recipient's QR code to make your first payment.
onboarding.feature2: Your keys stay on your phone
onboarding.feature3: Every payment kept as a receipt
onboarding.welcomeBody: Scan a recipient's QR code and pay in FTC. Your wallet lives on this phone — nothing leaves the device until you confirm a payment.

paymentDetails.name: Full name
paymentDetails.privacyNote: These details stay on this phone. They are only used to fill the payment record — ANTON Pay never sends them anywhere on its own.
paymentDetails.subtitle: Your name and address are added to the ISO 20022 record of every payment you make. All fields are optional.
paymentDetails.title: Payment details

paymentDone.body: Your payment has been recorded on this device. The recipient settles it through Safello.
paymentDone.title: Payment recorded

receive.qrAddressOnly: QR carries only your address — sender chooses the amount
receive.title: Receive

recoveryPhrase.gateDenied: Biometric check did not pass. Recovery phrase remains hidden.
recoveryPhrase.notAvailable: No recovery phrase stored on this device.
recoveryPhrase.reveal: I am alone — show me the phrase
recoveryPhrase.title: Recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.warning: Anyone who sees these 24 words can spend your funds. Look around — no cameras, no shoulders. Never screenshot, photograph, or share them.

restore.bad24: Recovery phrase must be exactly 24 words.
restore.body: Enter your 24 words separated by spaces. This will replace any wallet currently on this device.
restore.invalidMnemonic: That isn't a valid BIP-39 phrase. Check each word.
restore.title: Restore from recovery phrase

review.expiredBody: This QR code is no longer valid. Ask the recipient to show you a fresh one.

iso.note: This payment maps to an ISO 20022 PACS.008 credit transfer. Add your details in Settings → Payment details.
iso.title: ISO 20022 payment details

review.paymentTypeHelp: Only "Payment" counts toward tax. Gift, Information and Contract are exempt.
review.lookAlikeAck: I confirm this address is NOT "{{name}}" and I want to pay this new address.
review.lookAlikeBody: This address looks similar to your contact "{{name}}" but is NOT the same. Attackers grind addresses with matching head/tail to trick recipients. Verify the full address before paying.
review.notePlaceholder: For internal use — what this payment is for, any agreement.
review.title: Review payment

rpc.help: Which FutureChain node this app talks to for balance, UTXOs, and submitting signed transactions. Default is the public Bahnhof hub.
rpc.title: RPC endpoint
rpc.urlHint: For a phone-tethered local node, use http://127.0.0.1:8546 with adb reverse.

manualPay.errAddress: Enter a valid fc_… wallet address.
manualPay.errAmount: Enter a valid amount in FTC.
manualPay.errName: Enter the recipient's name — it's required for the payment to settle.
manualPay.hint: Name + country are required so the payment can settle. For amounts ≥ €1000, also add the recipient's street, city and postcode.
manualPay.name: Recipient name

scan.cameraErrorBody: ANTON Pay couldn't open the camera. Check the app's camera permission, or enter the payment code manually.
scan.hint: Point at the recipient's QR code
scan.invalidUri: That isn't a valid ANTON payment code.
scan.invalidUriExpired: This payment code has expired. Ask the recipient for a fresh QR.
scan.manualHint: Paste the futurechain:pay link from the recipient.
scan.title: Scan to pay

schedules.confirmDelete: Delete this scheduled payment? No more reminders will fire.
schedules.disclaimer: When the reminder fires, you tap to sign each occurrence. ANTON does not auto-pay. This is not a SEPA standing order or PSP service — it's a reminder with explicit consent each cycle.
schedules.emptyBody: Add your first one — rent, gym, streaming subscription.
schedules.help: Set up reminders for recurring payments — rent, subscriptions, monthly bills. When a reminder fires you tap the notification, biometric-confirm, and the payment signs at that moment. ANTON never auto-pays without you.
schedules.invalidAddress: Payee address must be an fc_… address.
schedules.title: Scheduled payments

settings.appLockEnableReason: Confirm to turn on the app lock

settings.appearanceHelp: Pick an accent colour and a light or dark theme.
settings.friendsSub: Saved contacts you pay — names instead of addresses
settings.micaDisclosure: FTC settlement is routed through Bahnhof's public light-hub at rpc.futurechain.eu. Bahnhof operates this hub under Sweden Finansinspektionen (FI) authorisation pending publication; once issued, the CASP authorisation number will appear here.
settings.moneyProfileSub: Your usual money pattern — helps spot unusual payments
settings.paymentDetailsSub: Your name and address for payment records
settings.taxResidencySub: Country we use to estimate potential taxes
settings.resetConfirm: Reset the app? This permanently erases your wallet and all payment records on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetHelp: Erases your wallet and every payment record from this device. This cannot be undone — make sure you no longer need the wallet.
settings.restoreSub: Replace this device's wallet with one from a recovery phrase
settings.rpcEndpointSub: Which FutureChain node this app talks to
settings.title: Settings
settings.travelRuleNote: Payments above €1000 require the EU Travel Rule (Reg. 2023/1113) originator info — your profile in Payment details supplies these fields.

tax.residencyDeclared: Residency is declared, not inferred from your location. Re-confirm yearly or whenever it changes. If you live in multiple countries during the year, talk to a tax adviser — ANTON doesn't split jurisdictions.
tax.residencyHelp: Pick the country you're tax resident in. We use this to apply the right rules — it stays on this device.

travelRule.fullBody: This payment exceeds the EU Travel Rule threshold (€1000). EU 2023/1113 requires the originator address fields to be included.
travelRule.missing: Missing: {{fields}}. Open Settings → Payment details to complete.
travelRule.noRateBody: No live FTC/EUR rate available. Conservative posture: payments are treated as above the EU Travel Rule €1000 threshold until the rate source is back online.
travelRule.title: Profile required for this amount

wallet.addressHelp: Share this address to receive FTC. It is safe to show — only your private key can spend from it.
